map_path.slice_title: Map Path, Continue, And Route Return
map_path.player_action: Resume a run, inspect route ownership, and return through locked reward or shop boundaries
map_path.system_response: Show real route graph state, continue landing, locked-surface recovery, and owned path transitions without hidden state

semantics_defaults.empty: Show no active route ownership until autosave or current run route data is available.
semantics_defaults.failure: Show continue denial, locked-surface refusal, or invalid route recovery explicitly instead of silently falling back.
semantics_defaults.completion: Player can resume into the correct map or combat boundary and read owned route transitions from visible map surfaces.

screen_contract.must_show: reachable route graph, selected path, continue landing, locked-surface restore state, and refusal feedback.
screen_contract.must_not_hide: invalid route ownership, locked return-path refusal, or continue-boundary denial behind logs only.
screen_contract.validation_focus: map graph visibility, continue landing, locked-surface recovery, and route-owned return behavior.

screen_state.entry_state: show map or continue entry only when route ownership is known.
screen_state.interaction_state: show reachable nodes, selected route, and restore or return choices.
screen_state.failure_state: show continue denial, missing autosave, or locked-surface refusal explicitly.
screen_state.recovery_exit: retry continue, return to map, or return to the owned route boundary.

combat_card_play.player_action: Inspect cards, drag or click to play them, and target legal enemies during combat
combat_card_play.system_response: Show data-driven card text, legal targeting feedback, and CombatService-backed card-play resolution without scene-local branches

semantics_defaults.empty: Show no playable hand or targeting preview until combat runtime and hand state are available.
semantics_defaults.failure: Show invalid target, missing definition, or rejected play feedback without mutating energy, HP, or pile state.
semantics_defaults.completion: Player can read localized card content, target legal enemies, and resolve card plays through the shared combat runtime path.

screen_contract.must_show: localized card text, cost, target preview, legal target highlight, and card-play feedback.
screen_contract.must_not_hide: invalid target refusal, rejected play, or missing-definition fallback behind logs only.
screen_contract.validation_focus: card text binding, drag or click play, legal targeting, and CombatService-backed play resolution.

screen_state.entry_state: show hand and available play actions only when combat runtime is ready.
screen_state.interaction_state: show card hover, drag preview, selected target, and resolved play feedback.
screen_state.failure_state: show rejected play or invalid target without consuming state.
screen_state.recovery_exit: cancel targeting, return card to hand, or continue combat.

combat_runtime_bootstrap.slice_title: Combat Runtime Bootstrap And Deck State
combat_runtime_bootstrap.ui_entry: Combat HUD / Deck State / Runtime Bootstrap Surfaces
combat_runtime_bootstrap.player_action: Enter combat, inspect deck lifecycle state, and read warrior deck or Rage-backed runtime setup
combat_runtime_bootstrap.system_response: Show DeckService-backed piles, reshuffle timing, deck totals, warrior starting state, and Rage visibility from shared runtime ownership

semantics_defaults.empty: Show no deck lifecycle or player runtime bootstrap state until CombatService and DeckService ownership are ready.
semantics_defaults.failure: Show missing deck state, invalid reshuffle, or bootstrap denial explicitly instead of using scene-local counters.
semantics_defaults.completion: Player can read shared deck lifecycle state, warrior starting deck setup, and Rage-backed runtime state from governed combat surfaces.

screen_contract.must_show: draw, discard, exhaust, reshuffle, deck total, starting deck ownership, and player runtime bootstrap state.
screen_contract.must_not_hide: scene-local pile ownership, missing reshuffle feedback, or bootstrap fallback behind logs only.
screen_contract.validation_focus: DeckService-backed pile truth, reshuffle visibility, warrior deck bootstrap, and Rage runtime state.

screen_state.entry_state: show no deck or bootstrap state until combat runtime is established.
screen_state.interaction_state: show live draw, discard, exhaust, total-count, and player runtime status updates.
screen_state.failure_state: show bootstrap or pile-state mismatch explicitly.
screen_state.recovery_exit: retry combat entry or continue once shared runtime ownership is restored.

enemy_intent.slice_title: Enemy Intent, Turn Resolution, And Definitions
enemy_intent.ui_entry: Enemy Intent Preview / Enemy Runtime Surfaces
enemy_intent.player_action: Read enemy intents, verify no-repeat guardrails, and understand invalid-definition fallback during combat
enemy_intent.system_response: Show data-backed enemy previews, multi-enemy routing, resolved enemy turns, and invalid-definition fallback as visible combat state

semantics_defaults.empty: Show no enemy intent or roster state until runtime enemies are instantiated.
semantics_defaults.failure: Show invalid enemy-definition fallback, illegal target rejection, or no-repeat guard refusal explicitly.
semantics_defaults.completion: Player can inspect multi-enemy state, enemy intent previews, resolved enemy turns, and invalid-definition fallback on governed surfaces.

screen_contract.must_show: enemy roster, current intent, selected target state, resolved enemy turn feedback, and invalid-definition fallback notice.
screen_contract.must_not_hide: enemy-definition rejection, illegal selection, or no-repeat guard outcome behind logs only.
screen_contract.validation_focus: enemy preview visibility, multi-enemy routing, turn resolution, and invalid-definition fallback.

screen_state.entry_state: show no enemy preview until runtime enemies are ready.
screen_state.interaction_state: show selected enemy, intent preview, and resolved enemy-turn outcomes.
screen_state.failure_state: show invalid-definition or illegal-target refusal explicitly.
screen_state.recovery_exit: clear selection, continue combat, or await valid runtime enemy state.

combat_rules.player_action: Read status effects, turn resolution, AOE or multi-hit ordering, and defeat or trigger outcomes during live combat
combat_rules.system_response: Expose promoted rules, trigger hooks, fixed-damage ordering, and player-visible feedback without mutating deterministic combat ownership

semantics_defaults.empty: Show no status, trigger, or resolution history until combat rules are active.
semantics_defaults.failure: Show blocked trigger, invalid ordering, or single-resolution guard refusal instead of leaving stale combat feedback.
semantics_defaults.completion: Player can read statuses, trigger ordering, defeat resolution, and multi-hit or AOE feedback from governed combat surfaces.

screen_contract.must_show: status stacks, trigger outcomes, fixed-damage ordering, defeat resolution, and player-visible combat feedback.
screen_contract.must_not_hide: trigger refusal, stale status state, or duplicate defeat resolution behind logs only.
screen_contract.validation_focus: status visibility, trigger ordering, defeat guardrails, and promoted combat feedback.

screen_state.entry_state: show no rule-derived feedback until combat events begin.
screen_state.interaction_state: show live status updates, trigger outcomes, and resolution history.
screen_state.failure_state: show duplicate resolution or invalid trigger ordering explicitly.
screen_state.recovery_exit: acknowledge feedback and continue combat under the shared runtime owner.

reward_flow.slice_title: Reward Offer, Confirm, And Return Flow
reward_flow.ui_entry: Reward Scene / Offer Choice / Return Path
reward_flow.player_action: Inspect reward offers, select one of three choices, skip when allowed, and return to the owned route boundary
reward_flow.system_response: Render stable offer locking, invalid-pool fallback, confirm gating, writeback, and route-owned return behavior

semantics_defaults.empty: Show no reward offers until the current reward boundary resolves a valid offer set.
semantics_defaults.failure: Show invalid-pool fallback, re-entry lock refusal, or confirm or skip rejection explicitly instead of mutating route state silently.
semantics_defaults.completion: Player can inspect a stable three-offer reward set, confirm or skip exactly once, and return through the owned route boundary.

screen_contract.must_show: three-offer reward set, lock persistence, selected-card confirmation state, skip state, and route-owned return feedback.
screen_contract.must_not_hide: invalid-pool fallback, confirm denial, skip denial, or duplicate resolution behind logs only.
screen_contract.validation_focus: offer generation, lock persistence, confirm gating, writeback, and route-owned return behavior.

screen_state.entry_state: show no reward selection until the offer set is resolved.
screen_state.interaction_state: show selected reward, confirm or skip affordances, and return-path state.
screen_state.failure_state: show invalid pool or duplicate confirm or skip refusal explicitly.
screen_state.recovery_exit: confirm reward, skip reward, or return through the owned route boundary.

relic_participants.slice_title: Relics, Powers, Potions, And Shared Triggers
relic_participants.ui_entry: Relic Display / Participant HUD / Shared Trigger Feedback
relic_participants.player_action: Acquire relics, inspect equipped participants, and understand combat or run-trigger effects from powers, relics, and potions
relic_participants.system_response: Show acquisition, equip state, participant visibility, and both combat-boundary and run-boundary trigger outcomes on governed surfaces

semantics_defaults.empty: Show no relic, power, or potion participant state until shared run or combat ownership is available.
semantics_defaults.failure: Show participant fallback, trigger refusal, or missing equip state explicitly instead of hiding it behind shared runtime logs.
semantics_defaults.completion: Player can inspect equipped relics, visible powers and potions, and shared trigger outcomes across combat and run boundaries.

screen_contract.must_show: relic acquisition, equipped participants, potion or power participant visibility, and trigger feedback across combat and run boundaries.
screen_contract.must_not_hide: missing equip state, trigger refusal, or participant fallback behind logs only.
screen_contract.validation_focus: relic acquisition, participant visibility, combat-trigger feedback, and run-trigger feedback.

screen_state.entry_state: show no participant surfaces until shared run or combat ownership is established.
screen_state.interaction_state: show equipped participants, trigger outcomes, and participant-affecting runtime changes.
screen_state.failure_state: show missing participant state or trigger refusal explicitly.
screen_state.recovery_exit: continue combat or run flow once participant ownership is restored.

settlement.slice_title: Settlement Summary, Metadata, And Resume Evidence
settlement.ui_entry: Run Summary / Settlement / Resume Evidence Surfaces
settlement.player_action: Inspect stored-data-backed summary output, verify reward and relic settlement metadata, and confirm resume evidence after a run
settlement.system_response: Render settlement ownership, reward or relic metadata, and resume evidence from stored run data instead of partial placeholder summaries

semantics_defaults.empty: Show no settlement summary until stored run data is available for the selected run.
semantics_defaults.failure: Show missing settlement metadata, missing reward or relic fields, or absent resume evidence explicitly instead of showing partial placeholder summaries.
semantics_defaults.completion: Player can inspect stored settlement outcome, reward or relic metadata, and resume evidence from governed summary surfaces.

screen_contract.must_show: stored run outcome, reward or relic metadata, and resume evidence linked to the same settlement owner surface.
screen_contract.must_not_hide: missing settlement metadata or missing resume evidence behind partial placeholder summaries.
screen_contract.validation_focus: stored-data summary ownership, metadata visibility, and resume evidence visibility.

screen_state.entry_state: show no settlement data until a stored run summary is selected.
screen_state.interaction_state: show summary outcome, reward or relic metadata, and resume evidence together.
screen_state.recovery_exit: close summary, return to run flow, or inspect another stored settlement.

screen_contract.must_not_hide: missing audit evidence or governance gaps behind implementation-only notes.
screen_contract.validation_focus: audit readability and governed evidence paths for architecture, security, and sizing.
